reuse.why: Changes the rule inside getScheduledAmount, the single helper that every planned-amount consumer in the tree (API model, forecast, schedules app, template, preview, client) already calls.

duplication.why: No logic copied; both branches become a single expression each.

placement.why: The edit sits in shared/schedules.ts where the rule is defined.

scope.why: Only the rule, its tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Simpler than before (Math.min and amount - threshold), with the variable renamed to match the new meaning.
